description: This file defines an abstract class 'FieldItemBase' for Drupal, representing a base class for entity field items with methods for managing field settings, properties, and entity interactions.

classes.name: FieldItemBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for entity field items in Drupal, extending Map and implementing FieldItemInterface, providing core functionality for field item management.

methods.name: defaultStorageSettings
methods.description: Returns default storage settings as an empty array.

methods.name: defaultFieldSettings
methods.description: Returns default field settings as an empty array.

methods.name: storageSettingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of storage settings based on the storage definition.

methods.name: fieldSettingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of field settings based on the field definition.

methods.name: mainPropertyName
methods.description: Returns the main property name, 'value'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the field item, setting up computed properties.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the entity associated with this field item.

methods.name: getLangcode
methods.description: Retrieves the language code of the parent entity.

methods.name: getFieldDefinition
methods.description: Gets the field definition object.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Returns the array of field settings.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific field setting by name.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the field, handling non-array inputs.

methods.name: writePropertyValue
methods.description: Updates property values efficiently, avoiding object creation when possible.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to access properties or values.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to set property values.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a property or value is set.

methods.name: __unset
methods.description: Unsets a property or value.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Returns a view of the field item for display.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Hook before saving the field item.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Hook after saving the field item.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the field item.

methods.name: generateSampleValue
methods.description: Generates a sample value for the field.

methods.name: deleteRevision
methods.description: Deletes a revision of the field item.

methods.name: storageSettingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form for storage settings.

methods.name: fieldSettingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form for field settings.

methods.name: storageSettingsToConfigData
methods.description: Converts storage settings to config data.

methods.name: storageSettingsFromConfigData
methods.description: Loads storage settings from config data.

methods.name: fieldSettingsToConfigData
methods.description: Converts field settings to config data.

methods.name: fieldSettingsFromConfigData
methods.description: Loads field settings from config data.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates dependencies for the field.

methods.name: calculateStorageDependencies
methods.description: Calculates storage dependencies for the field.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles removal of dependencies.
